assertions.rationale: Correctly identifies System.TimeProvider as the replacement for the custom IClock, matching the well-known modern .NET pattern.

assertions.assertion: Uses GetUtcNow() method instead of UtcNow property
assertions.rationale: Uses _timeProvider.GetUtcNow() and explicitly notes it is a method replacing the UtcNow property.

assertions.assertion: TimeProvider is injected via constructor (standard DI)
assertions.rationale: Injects TimeProvider through the constructor via standard DI and discusses registration/faking.

assertions.assertion: Does NOT reference Duende.IdentityServer.IClock or ICancellationTokenProvider
assertions.rationale: The final code uses neither; IClock appears only as the abstraction being removed and ICancellationTokenProvider is not mentioned.
